findings.description: Across front, back, three-quarter, neutral, arms-up, and arm-cross the overskirt remains a smooth flared shell with only faint irregular facets; repeated sewn pleat lines and lamé identity are not legible at product-view scale even with 24 mm relief.

Side views show an abrupt projecting front panel and detached rigid waist transition. Crouch and sit expose irregular overlapping/dangling panels below the rear hem, while prone produces broad petal-like lobes rather than controlled pleats.
Neutral front/back/side views retain triangular lower-bodice facets and an uneven jacket-to-skirt waist ledge; the overskirt appears detached in profile.

nextAction: V126 increased panel-local radial relief from 8 mm to 24 mm, but direct inspection and Astra review of all eleven current renders still reject the smooth skirt surface, detached side profile, and uncontrolled crouch/sit/prone folds. Keep REJECT. Next geometry work must address waist attachment/profile and controlled hip/rear-hem deformation; pleat visibility must be assessed in fresh renders. Fit, deformation/weights, shape keys, Unity/VRChat execution, package and release remain unapproved.
